title: Christina Aguilera Soaks Up The Last Days Of Summer In A Fiery Red Swimsuit Photoshoot On An Ice Cream Truck As Fans Swoon: 'Looking Better Than Ever!' - NewsBreak
text: Christina Aguilera has been super active on social media, and these days, she’s wearing outfits that pull extra attention towards her impressive weight loss. The pop singer recently shared some pictures of herself posing in an elaborate summer-themed photoshoot that involved an ice cream truck and a teeny tiny red bikini. While it’s unclear why she had such a professional shoot for an Instagram post, fans are in awe of how great she looks , and left plenty of comments about it. She’s been boasting about her intuitive eating lifestyle, which seems to certainly be working for her, considering the internet’s reactions to her photos. Read more about the new bikini snaps below. If there's one thing the vocalist is going to do, it's pose for a fun photoshoot and share the pictures on Instagram. Even if she doesn't have a big project to promote, she's always down to get in front of the camera and share her photogenic skills with her fan base, who are always there to cheer her on. Recently, she posted several pictures of herself on Instagram that screamed summer, as she was dressed in a vintage-looking, fiery red bikini and posed in front of a colorful ice cream truck. The bikini had a super cute fit with some white embellishments, like a little string bow in the front of the top. The retro feel could be seen in the bottoms, which were more high-waisted and had some retro-looking pockets. You can see her pictures here! Christina paired the bright red swimsuit with a pair of light, ripped-up denim jeans, which she wore open and rolled down, to show off her bottom. She also had on a baseball cap, large sunglasses, and high heels, making it an outfit that looked like one she would've worn in the late 90s or early 2000s. She put up a peace sign as she held an orange ice cream pop, and in one of her captions, wrote "licky licky yum yum." 'X-tina' has undergone a transformation over the last few years, as fans and pop culture enthusiasts have noticed she's lost a decent amount of weight, with some reports stating she's lost around 40 pounds. She has spoken about her diet and lifestyle habits in the past, allegedly following the Rainbow Diet , which includes eating a wide array of colors of fruits and vegetables throughout the day. However, in more recent interviews, she's boasted about stopping fad diets and following an intuitive eating lifestyle, where she focuses on fueling herself when she's hungry and stopping when she's full. Whatever she's doing, it's definitely working, as she flaunted her toned torso in her new ice cream truck photoshoot. Like most of her social media posts, on Instagram, her fanbase weighed in on how great they thought she looked and how much they loved the fun, summery shoot. "The 2000s are definitely back!" wrote an Instagram user, as other fans called her "stunning" and "gorgeous." "Looking better than ever," commented a user. "I swear you are aging in reverse." "Girl, you look great," added a fan. "How do you look like this?!" asked an admirer. "So wild." We'll be curious to see if Christina's ice cream truck photoshoot ends up being to promote new music, which her fans are begging for, or if it's just a chic way to close out the summer. Either way, her followers are eating it up.
